title: The Weekend - Going to the Beach

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
My name is Marco.
My name is Catherine and today we've got an intermediate level lesson all about going to the beach.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们有一个关于去海滩的中级课程。

segments.en: That's right.
You know, it's a very popular thing to do, especially during the summer.
segments.zh: 你知道，这是一件非常受欢迎的事情，尤其是在夏天。

segments.en: It's hot.
You want to go maybe to the beach to lay on the sand and maybe get some color.
segments.zh: 你想去海滩躺在沙滩上，也许还能晒出点颜色。

segments.en: And also swim in the ocean.
Yeah.
Yeah, it's a nice way to cool off when it's really hot in the summer.
segments.zh: 是的，当夏天真的很热时，这是一种降温的好方法。

segments.en: That's right.
We're going to talk about the beach and a lot of vocab that we find related to this activity.
segments.zh: 我们将讨论海滩和我们发现与这项活动相关的许多词汇。

segments.en: But before we get into the dialogue, we have a word for you on Vocabulary Preview.
segments.zh: 但在进入对话之前，我们有一个词要讲，就在词汇预览里。

segments.en: Vocabulary Preview.
So the keyword today here is jellyfish.
segments.zh: 所以今天这里的关键词是水母。

segments.en: Jellyfish.
So jellyfish is actually an animal, right?
segments.zh: 所以水母实际上是一种动物，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
It's a very dangerous animal.
segments.zh: 这是一种非常危险的动物。

segments.en: It's a small little animal.
So these things live in the water and they often live in shallow areas and they can sting you.
segments.zh: 所以这种东西生活在水中，常常出现在浅水区，还会蜇人。

segments.en: That's right.
They look like little plastic bags with little strings attached to it.
segments.zh: 它们看起来像小塑料袋，上面系着小绳子。

segments.en: And they just float around and if you happen to touch one, it hurts a lot.
segments.zh: 它们就这么漂来漂去，你要是碰巧碰到一只，会非常痛。

segments.en: Yeah, it can be very painful.
So jellyfish is our word today.
segments.zh: 所以 jellyfish 就是我们今天的词。

segments.en: Let's take a listen to today's dialogue and we'll be back in a minute to talk more about what's going on.
segments.zh: 让我们听听今天的对话，我们会在一分钟内回来讨论正在发生的事情。

segments.en: Oh George, what a beautiful day it is.
segments.zh: 哦，乔治，这是多么美好的一天。

segments.en: The sun is hot and there are just a few clouds scattered here and there.
segments.zh: 太阳很晒，天上只有几朵零星的云。

segments.en: What a perfect day to be at the beach.
segments.zh: 在海滩上度过这样一天，真是太完美了。

segments.en: The kids are going to have so much fun and we'll be able to relax in the sun while they're playing.
segments.zh: 孩子们会玩得很开心，我们可以在玩耍时在阳光下放松身心。

segments.en: It does seem like the perfect day.
I'm glad we chose to get out of the city and enjoy the nice weather.
segments.zh: 我很高兴我们选择离开城市并享受好天气。

segments.en: This looks like the perfect spot.
segments.zh: 这看起来像是完美的地方。

segments.en: Okay kids, put on your sunscreen while your mom and I set up camp.
segments.zh: 孩子们，先涂防晒霜，我和你们妈妈把东西安置好。

segments.en: Here Mary, help me lay down these beach towels.
segments.zh: 来，玛丽，帮我铺一下这些沙滩巾。

segments.en: There we go.
Can you help me with the umbrella?
Perfect.
Okay kids, here's a beach ball and a frisbee, a pail and a shovel.
segments.zh: 好吧，孩子们，这是一个沙滩球和一个飞盘、一个桶和一把铁锹。

segments.en: I want to see an impressive sandcastle by the time we leave.
segments.zh: 当我们离开时，我想看到一座令人印象深刻的沙堡。

segments.en: Don't stray too far.
Wait, leave your sandals here or put on your wet shoes.
segments.zh: 等等，把凉鞋留在这儿，或者换上涉水鞋。

segments.en: And stay in the shallow area.
I don't want to see you go any further than that sandbar.
It's too deep out there and we didn't bring your floaties.
segments.zh: 那边水太深，而且我们没带你们的充气浮具。

segments.en: You're back already?
The water was too cold, huh?
I'll tell you a secret.
Do you see that small pool of water over there?
segments.zh: 你看到那边的小水池了吗？

segments.en: It'll be warmer in there.
Go see if you can find some seashells or catch some minnows.
segments.zh: 去看看你能不能找到一些贝壳或捕捉一些小鱼。

segments.en: Ah!
What is that?
A jellyfish?
Jeremy, put that down right now.
segments.zh: 杰里米，现在就把它放下。

segments.en: It could sting you.
Ah!
Not on me!
Ah!
Alright, great, we're back.
segments.zh: 好吧，太好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now why don't we take a look at four key words that we have prepared for you today on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们为什么不看看我们今天在语言要点中为你准备的四个关键词。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
First up, we have a very important thing to bring to the beach, especially if you're like me and you burn easily.
segments.zh: 首先，有一件去海滩一定要带的东西，尤其如果你像我一样容易晒伤。

segments.en: So this thing is called sunscreen.
Okay, sunscreen.
Now this is a liquid and you put it on your skin, right?
segments.zh: 它是一种液体，你把它涂在皮肤上，对吧？

segments.en: And this protects you from the sun.
segments.zh: 这可以保护您免受阳光照射。

segments.en: So basically you put this cream all over your body to prevent sunburns, to prevent burning under the sun.
segments.zh: 所以基本上你把这种乳霜涂遍全身，防止晒伤，防止在太阳下被晒伤。

segments.en: It's very important.
So it's called sunscreen or also sometimes called sunblock.
segments.zh: 所以它叫 sunscreen，有时也叫 sunblock。

segments.en: That's right.
Okay, very good.
Now we have our sunscreen and we arrive to the beach and one of the parents say, alright, we're going to set up camp.
segments.zh: 现在我们有了防晒霜，我们到达了海滩，其中一位父母说，好吧，我们要扎营。

segments.en: Okay, to set up camp.
Well, this might be confusing because as many of you know, camp, camping, this is an activity, but we're not actually camping here.
segments.zh: 好吧，这可能会令人困惑，因为你们中的许多人都知道，露营、露营，这是一项活动，但我们实际上并没有在这里露营。

segments.en: We're just going to be at the beach for one day.
segments.zh: 我们只要在海滩上待一天。

segments.en: So to set up camp means to organize or arrange ourselves in a place.
segments.zh: 所以设立营地意味着在一个地方组织或安排自己。

segments.en: So it's a colloquial way of saying we are going to organize the area where we're going to spend the day.
segments.zh: 所以这是一种口语说法，意思是我们把要待一天的那片地方布置好。

segments.en: We're going to make ourselves comfortable.
So you set up camp.
So not necessarily that you're going to camp there, but that you're going to prepare the area.
segments.zh: 所以不一定是你要去那里露营，而是你要准备这个区域。

segments.en: So this could be used in many other different areas, right?
segments.zh: 所以这可以在许多其他不同的领域使用，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
So sometimes when tickets for really popular concerts go on sale, people line up for days before they can buy the tickets.
segments.zh: 因此，有时当真正受欢迎的音乐会门票开始销售时，人们会排队几天才能购买门票。

segments.en: Well, if you're in line, you maybe want to set up camp.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果你在排队，你可能想建立营地。

segments.en: That means make yourself comfortable, sit down, bring a book, open some food packages.
segments.zh: 这意味着让自己舒适，坐下来，带一本书，打开一些食物包。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
So to set up camp.
And well, when we go to the beach, we want to sit down or lay down on the sand.
segments.zh: 好吧，当我们去海滩时，我们想坐下来或躺在沙滩上。

segments.en: And in order to do this, we usually bring along beach towels.
segments.zh: 为了做到这一点，我们通常会带上沙滩巾。

segments.en: That's right, Marco.
So towels can be any kind of towel.
segments.zh: 所以毛巾可以是任何类型的毛巾。

segments.en: You have a towel in your bathroom or in your kitchen.
segments.zh: 你的浴室或厨房里有一条毛巾。

segments.en: Basically a piece of cloth that you use to dry yourself.
segments.zh: 基本上是一块你用来擦干的布。

segments.en: But the special kind of towel we bring to the beach is called, of course, a beach towel.
segments.zh: 但我们带到海滩的特殊类型的毛巾当然被称为沙滩巾。

segments.en: These are usually much bigger than normal towels.
segments.zh: 这些通常比普通毛巾大得多。

segments.en: Yeah, they're very, very big.
And this is usually because you want to lay down on the sand on top of this towel, right?
segments.zh: 这通常是因为你想躺在这条毛巾上的沙滩上，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
Okay.
And the last word that we have for language takeaway is a beach umbrella or just an umbrella.
segments.zh: 语言要点的最后一个词是 beach umbrella，或者直接叫 umbrella。

segments.en: That's right.
So maybe you're lying down on this big, comfortable, soft beach towel, and you're afraid of being under the sun too much.
segments.zh: 所以也许你躺在这条大、舒适、柔软的沙滩巾上，你害怕在阳光下过多。

segments.en: So an umbrella is a way to protect yourself from the sun.
segments.zh: 所以雨伞是保护自己免受太阳伤害的一种方式。

segments.en: It provides shade.
That's right.
So it's called an umbrella.
Or usually if you want to distinguish between the umbrella you use for the rain, you can call it a beach umbrella.
segments.zh: 或者通常如果你想和挡雨用的伞区分开，可以叫它沙滩伞。

segments.en: That's right.
Okay.

segments.zh: 这些通常大得多，而且你并不是用手拿着到处走。

segments.en: You have to put them into the sand.
segments.zh: 你必须把它们放在沙子里。

segments.en: That's right.
So it stands alone.
Okay.

segments.zh: 所以在语言要点方面为您提供了四个关键短语。

segments.zh: 来，玛丽，帮我铺一下这些沙滩巾。

segments.en: Language Takeaway
Okay, so there are lots of fun things to do at the beach.
segments.zh: 好的，所以在海滩上有很多有趣的事情要做。

segments.en: And today we're not going to be talking about all of them because there are too many things.
segments.zh: 而今天我们不会谈论所有这些，因为事情太多了。

segments.en: But one fun activity is playing frisbee.
segments.zh: 但一项有趣的活动是玩飞盘。

segments.en: That's right, frisbee.
So this is a thing.
It's an object, a frisbee.
segments.zh: 它是一个对象，一个飞盘。

segments.en: Or you also play frisbee.
That's right.
So a frisbee itself is usually made of plastic and it's like a plate.
segments.zh: 所以飞盘本身通常是由塑料制成的，它就像一个盘子。

segments.en: And it's very light and you throw it to your friends and it sails through the air.
segments.zh: 它很轻，你把它扔给你的朋友，它在空中航行。

segments.en: Right, it kind of flies along the air and then somebody else has to catch it.
segments.zh: 对，它有点沿着空中飞，然后其他人必须抓住它。

segments.en: That's right.
So you can play frisbee or throw the frisbee.
segments.zh: 所以你可以玩飞盘或扔飞盘。

segments.en: It's very popular with people playing frisbee with their dogs, right?
segments.zh: 它很受与他们的狗玩飞盘的人的欢迎，对吧？

segments.en: You throw the frisbee and the dog chases it.
Dogs love frisbee.
Alright, another great activity that usually we do when we go to the beach is we build sand castles.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们去海滩时通常会做的另一项伟大活动是我们建造沙堡。

segments.en: Okay, so I'm a master sand castle builder.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我可是个沙堡大师。

segments.en: I'm a really big fan of this activity.
segments.zh: 我是这项活动的忠实粉丝。

segments.en: Really?
Basically, you use water and sand to create castles.
segments.zh: 基本上，您使用水和沙子来创建城堡。

segments.en: And obviously, you have to use tools like shovels and buckets.
segments.zh: 显然，您必须使用铲子和水桶等工具。

segments.en: Otherwise, it might look kind of funny.
segments.zh: 否则，它可能看起来很有趣。

segments.en: And this is actually such a popular activity that there are even competitions at times.
segments.zh: 这实际上是一项如此受欢迎的活动，有时甚至会有比赛。

segments.en: People will not only build castles or houses or structures but maybe a statue of some sort or an animal or different things.
segments.zh: 人们不仅会建造城堡、房屋或结构，还可能建造某种雕像、动物或不同的东西。

segments.en: That's right or people.
People, yeah.
So sand castle.
Okay.
And well, whenever we go to the beach, the ocean can be a little bit dangerous.
segments.zh: 好吧，每当我们去海滩时，海洋可能会有点危险。

segments.en: And that's why in the dialogue, one of the parents told their kids to stay in the shallow area of the water.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么在对话中，一位家长让孩子待在浅水区。

segments.en: That's right.
So shallow is it describes depth.
So how deep something is.
Something is shallow, it's not very deep.
segments.zh: 有些东西很浅，不是很深。

segments.en: So there's very little water.
But if there's a lot of water, maybe if you swim and you can't touch your feet on the ground, we call that deep.
segments.zh: 但如果水很多，比如你游泳时脚够不到水底，我们就说那是 deep。

segments.en: So shallow is very low water and deep is lots and lots of water.
segments.zh: 所以浅水非常低，深水很多。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
So you'll usually find this in the ocean.
segments.zh: 所以你通常会在海洋中找到这个。

segments.en: If you go further, further, further in, it'll get deeper and deeper and deeper.
segments.zh: 你越往里走，水就会越来越深。

segments.en: And more and more dangerous.
Right.
And this is why the mom also told the kid to not pass that sandbar that was ahead.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么妈妈还告诉孩子不要通过前面的沙洲。

segments.en: Okay, sandbar.
This is a piece of sand that basically rises very high in the water.
segments.zh: 就是水中一块隆起的沙地。

segments.en: So usually when you're on the beach and you go into the water and it gets deeper and deeper and then all of a sudden it gets high again and there's more sand.
segments.zh: 因此，通常当您在海滩上时，您进入水中，它变得越来越深，然后突然又变高了，沙子越来越多。

segments.en: And so that part that you can stand on, that sand out in the water, that's called a sandbar.
segments.zh: 所以你可以站立的那部分，水中的沙子，这就是所谓的沙洲。

segments.en: It's almost like a little island.
Yeah, exactly.
And as you said, usually it gets deeper, deeper, then you have the sandbar so it gets higher.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，它通常会变得更深、更深，然后你有沙洲，所以它变得更高。

segments.en: But usually if you pass the sandbar, it's going to get really deep all of a sudden.
segments.zh: 但通常如果你通过沙洲，它会突然变得非常深。

segments.en: That's right.
So that's why the mother doesn't want her child to go past the sandbar.
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么母亲不希望她的孩子经过沙洲。

segments.en: Right.
And as well, if you're ever swimming in a swimming pool in the ocean, it's always a good idea if you don't know how to swim well or if you have children to take along little floaties.
segments.zh: 而且，不管是在游泳池还是海里游泳，如果你不太会游泳，或者带着孩子，随身带些小浮具总是个好主意。

segments.en: Okay, floaties.
I like this word.
Floaties are plastic rings that you put around your arms or maybe around your stomach and they're filled with air.
segments.zh: 浮具是充气的塑料圈，套在手臂上或肚子上，里面充满空气。

segments.en: Right.
So when you go in the water, they help you float.
segments.zh: 所以当你下水时，它们会帮助你漂浮。

segments.en: Exactly.
So this is a very common thing to put on children because they don't know how to swim well.
segments.zh: 给小孩戴这个非常普遍，因为他们还不太会游泳。

segments.en: So you put them little floaties on their arms or around their stomachs and then they can just float and they won't drown.
segments.zh: 你给他们把浮具套在手臂上或肚子上，他们就能浮在水上，不会溺水。

segments.en: That's right.
Floaties.
Very good.
So a lot of key words there are related to the fun of going to the beach.
segments.zh: 所以很多关键词都与去海滩的乐趣有关。

segments.zh: 这是一个沙滩球和一个飞盘、一个桶和一个铁锹。

segments.en: I want to see an impressive sand castle by the time we leave.
segments.zh: 当我们离开时，我想看到一座令人印象深刻的沙堡。

segments.en: Don't stray too far.
Wait, leave your sandals here or put on your wet shoes.
segments.zh: 等等，把凉鞋留在这儿，或者换上涉水鞋。

segments.en: And stay in the shallow area.
I don't want to see you go any further than that sandbar.
It's too deep out there and we didn't bring your floaties.
segments.zh: 那边水太深，而且我们没带你们的充气浮具。

segments.en: You're back already?
The water was too cold, huh?
I'll tell you a secret.
Do you see that small pool of water over there?
segments.zh: 你看到那边的小水池了吗？

segments.en: It'll be warmer in there.
Go see if you can find some seashells or catch some minnows.
segments.zh: 去看看你能不能找到一些贝壳或捕捉一些小鱼。

segments.en: Ah!

A jellyfish?

segments.en: It could sting you.
Ah!

Ah!

segments.zh: 你说你可是个沙堡大师。

segments.en: I love building sand castles.
I won't say that I'm very good at it.
Maybe not a professional.
But I do a pretty good sand castle.
segments.zh: 不过我能堆出很不错的沙堡。

segments.en: Do you like getting buried in the sand?
I love it.
Really?

segments.zh: 有没有人用沙子把你埋起来，然后你就动不了了？

segments.en: Yeah.
Yeah, so it's a little bit scary.
Obviously I'm not very comfortable with having my head covered.
segments.zh: 显然，我对遮住头部不太舒服。

segments.en: But some people even do that.
They cover their entire body, head to toe.
segments.zh: 他们把整个身体都埋起来，从头到脚。

segments.en: How do they breathe?
And they have a straw out of their mouth to breathe.
segments.zh: 他们嘴里叼着一根吸管来呼吸。

segments.en: Wow.
I actually love going to the beach and it's relaxing, it's really fun.
segments.zh: 我真的很喜欢去海滩，它很放松，真的很有趣。

segments.en: But I don't really enjoy it going when there are a lot of people.
segments.zh: 但如果人很多，我就不太喜欢去了。

segments.en: Because I like to relax on the beach.
segments.zh: 因为我喜欢在海滩上放松。

segments.en: But when there are too many people, they're running around, there are kids running around and it's not very relaxing.

segments.zh: 但在海里游泳也很危险，对吧？
